_notes: Lexeme blocklists for battery stimulus text (WEEK_PLAN authoring rule: no giveaway vocabulary).
Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive, applied by src/battery/validate_battery.py to the
stimulus fields defined in data/battery/battery_schema.md (scope researcher-confirmed 2026-07-30).
'global' applies to every item; 'per_value' lists apply to items whose values match.
Adding a value or a lexeme is a one-line edit to 'per_value'.
Seed lists per session task spec 2026-07-30; care + privacy lists researcher-ratified 2026-07-30.
Inflectional variants are NOT auto-derived — extend lists explicitly.
care: the bare word 'care/cared/caring' is deliberately NOT blocked (too common and polysemous);
it is an authoring DISCIPLINE item only — reviewers watch for value-loaded uses by hand.
